name: Fable: The Missing Apple Pie
source:
This fangame is set after the ending of Fable but before the start of the Lost Chapters content.

To celebrate Albion's new-found peace, the Guildmaster decides to throw a big party at the Guild. Some of Albion's finest Heroes are invited to an evening of good food and party games!

However, before the games can begin, a dastardly crime takes place. A murder? Worse. The Guildmaster's apple pie is stolen by one of the guests!

You play as Renwick, one of the Guildmaster's finest apprentices. Can you solve the mystery of the missing apple pie?

[From [url=https://alexanderthealright.itch.io/fable-the-missing-apple-pie]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这款同人游戏的时间设定在《神鬼寓言》结局之后、《失落之章》的故事开始之前。

为庆祝阿尔比恩重获和平，公会会长决定在公会举办一场盛大的宴会。阿尔比恩最出色的几位英雄受邀前来，享受美食与派对游戏！

然而，游戏还没开始，一桩卑劣的罪行就发生了。谋杀？更糟。会长的苹果派，被某位宾客偷走了！

你将扮演会长最出色的学徒之一伦威克。你能解开苹果派失踪之谜吗？

[摘自[url=https://alexanderthealright.itch.io/fable-the-missing-apple-pie]itch.io[/url]]
